title: ExportMeta
description:
The sidecar `hpr sim --export` writes beside a CSV recording, `flight.meta.json` for
`flight.csv`: the program that wrote the recording (the `tool` every document opens with) and
what it records. A CSV opens cleanly in a spreadsheet only without comment lines, so these go
here (the product system's `data.md`, ADR-174).

configuration.description: The configuration flown, as `hpr sim` names it, such as `[C6-5]`.

design.description: The design flown, by its file name.

file.description: The recording, by its file name.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description:
The program that wrote a document or a file: the title block every `--json` document, every
file `hpr` writes and `hpr --version` carry (ADR-164; the product system's `data.md`: "Every
export carries the designation and version of the tool that made it").

designation.description: Its designation in the FusionSpace product system: `FS-ACHERNAR · SW · TOOL 001`.
